name: landing
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design V3 of Korean Salus personal meal/health/recipe service: preserve an elegant warm editorial V1 identity but REMOVE ALL food photos and ALL decorative food illustrations/shapes. ABSOLUTE NO photographs anywhere, no vegetables, bowls, plates, cutlery illustrations, food silhouettes, 3D objects, mascots, abstract blobs or substitute hero artwork. Do NOT fill removed photos with grey image placeholders. The design itself is typography, whitespace, thin rules and useful real interface content. Sophisticated but approachable Korean consumer software. Palette warm ivory #F7F6F2, charcoal #232820, deep olive #384B33, understated warm grey borders. Roman serif "Salus" wordmark, small simple leaf mark allowed ONLY next to logo. Korean typography refined sans, deliberate large display headings on marketing screen, sensible compact UI on functional screens. Restrained 8-10px radii, minimal shadows, accurate hierarchy, tasteful editorial numeric section markers. Flat solid colors, no gradients, purple, sparkles, robots, glass effects, excessive pills or nested card grids. Crisp beautifully legible Korean text, no lorem ipsum or invented testimonials, metrics, certifications, medical promises. Realistic complete polished UI screen mockup, orthographic front view, no hardware frames or presentation annotations. Landscape 2400x1600 composition left 76% desktop viewport and right 24% matching mobile viewport separated by thin neutral gutter. All screens use the same brand. Navigation for authenticated product must be exactly 요리 찾기, 식사 기록, 내 레시피, 건강 정보; do not invent shopping features. Food DISH NAMES as text are allowed, actual food IMAGES and decorative illustrations are strictly forbidden. Photography-free does not mean generic dashboard: prioritize beautifully composed typography and real cooking workflow.
LANDING PAGE. Header Salus, 이용 방법, 요금 안내, 로그인, small olive 시작하기. Two column hero with generous ivory whitespace and hairline separators. Left small eyebrow "매일의 식사, 나에게 맞게." Large Korean headline "오늘은 뭘 먹을까요.\n내 몸에 맞춰 골라요." Short description "취향과 건강 정보를 바탕으로 요리를 찾고, 오늘의 식사로 기록하세요." Primary dark olive "오늘 먹을 요리 찾기" and understated text link "먼저 둘러보기". Right a REAL PRODUCT PREVIEW arranged like a carefully typeset notebook, NOT illustration: compact header "오늘의 요리 찾기", user message "두부와 계란으로 간단한 저녁", slim response block title "두부 달걀 덮밥", text "15분 · 1인분", simple mini ingredients list "두부 / 달걀 / 밥 / 대파", small muted status "알레르기 정보 미입력", and olive "레시피 보기 →". No dish thumbnails. Beneath hero full-width 3-column textual numbered workflow "01 나를 알려주고" "02 요리를 고르고" "03 식사로 남겨요", each with one short supporting line. Then editorial list section "냉장고 속 재료부터 시작해도 좋아요." 3 horizontal TEXT ONLY recipe rows with dish name left, small ingredient list center, timing right and arrow. Dishes 양배추 닭고기찜, 두부 달걀 덮밥, 들기름 메밀국수. No empty thumbnail boxes, no food icons. Footer concise legal links. Mobile same headline, CTA, compact useful product preview, steps. Composition should look complete without any images, beautifully balanced not empty.
